title: tanacetum virgatum
intro: Tanacetum virgatum, commonly known as Tansy or Bitter Buttons, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia. The plant is used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum virgatum include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve spasms, and act as a mild sedative. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
